find: Robert Merton, writing in Social Theory and Social Structure (1938, enlarged 1968), developed Durkheim’s concept of anomie into a systematic theory of crime.
replace: Robert Merton, in his 1938 article “Social Structure and Anomie”, developed Durkheim’s concept of anomie into a systematic theory of crime. He took the argument further in his later book Social Theory and Social Structure.

note: F2: Dutch policy is tolerance, not legalisation. The cross-cultural point is kept as a difference in enforcement.
